intro: Here are ready-made ideas, grouped by part of the business. Each card shows what starts it, what the agent does, what you approve, a rough time saving and how tricky it is to set up. Tap 'Build this' to take any idea into the Agent Builder.
saves: You don't need to invent agents from scratch. Pick one card that matches your most annoying weekly job and start there.
timeNote: Time savings are illustrative estimates for a small, part-time business. Your mileage will vary.

difficulty.1: Starter: under 15 minutes to set up

items.title: Enquiry triage and first replies
items.trigger: A new enquiry email arrives (or you paste one in)
does: Pulls out the brief: dates, who's travelling, budget, wishes
Lists what's missing
Drafts a warm first reply asking the right questions
items.approve: You read the draft, tweak it and press send

items.title: Itinerary first drafts
items.trigger: You paste in a client brief
does: Suggests a day-by-day outline
Proposes 2 to 3 hotel or resort options to investigate
Notes what to verify with suppliers
items.approve: You check every hotel, price and transfer before it goes near the client

items.title: Trip countdown emails
does: Checks your calendar or departures list for trips 7 days out
Drafts a friendly reminder: documents, weather outlook, packing tips
items.approve: You check entry and document advice, then send

items.title: Supplier and promo digest
does: Reads the week's supplier emails and newsletters
Summarises new offers, deadlines and fam trips
Flags anything relevant to your current clients
items.approve: Nothing to approve. It's just for you

items.title: Post-trip review requests
does: Drafts a personal welcome-home note
Asks for a review or testimonial, with the link
items.approve: You personalise and send. Only to clients happy to hear from you

items.title: Social content batching
items.trigger: Sunday evening, or when you upload photos
does: Turns your trip photos and current offers into a week of posts
Writes captions and suggests hashtags
Can create designs if connected to Canva
items.approve: You check facts and offers, then post yourself

items.title: Weekly content calendar
does: Plans 7 days of posts mixing travel inspiration, tips and opportunity posts
Drafts captions within the rules: no income claims
items.approve: You review the plan and schedule the posts

items.title: Lead follow-up reminders
does: Checks your leads list for anyone not contacted in 10+ days
Drafts a short, genuine follow-up message for each
items.approve: You copy, personalise and send from your own WhatsApp or DMs

items.title: New recruit onboarding assistant
items.trigger: A team member asks a question (you share the assistant or forward the question)
does: Answers only from your onboarding pack and FAQ
Points to the right training or document
Says 'ask {name}' when unsure
items.approve: Review its answers weekly at first. No earnings talk
items.saved: 1 hr a week as your team grows

items.title: Weekly team activity summary
does: Reads your team tracker spreadsheet
Summarises who's active, who's gone quiet, and who to congratulate
items.approve: Just for you. Use it to decide who to call

items.title: Inbox triage
does: Sorts new email into: needs you, can wait, newsletters, receipts
Drafts replies for simple ones
items.approve: You skim the 'needs you' list and check drafts

items.title: Business in 15 minutes
does: Summarises last week's emails and what's waiting on you
Lists upcoming departures and deadlines
Suggests your top 3 priorities for the week
items.approve: Just for you. Read it with your coffee
items.saved: 1 hr a week, plus peace of mind

items.title: Receipts and expenses tidy-up
does: Finds receipt emails from last month
Lists them in a spreadsheet by date, supplier, amount and category
items.approve: Glance at totals before your tax return
